title: Slice over Vector
goal: Change the function signature to accept array references and vectors without allocating.
hints: Look at the type of `numbers` in `main`. It is a fixed-size array, not a `Vec`.
Use slice borrowing `&[i32]` so both arrays and vectors coerce smoothly.
explanation: `&[i32]` accepts references to fixed arrays like `[i32; 3]` as well as references to `Vec<i32>` via deref coercion. Using `&Vec<i32>` forces fixed array owners to call `.to_vec()`, causing an unnecessary heap allocation. Passing `Vec<i32>` transfers ownership, which is even more restrictive. Design read-only collection parameters as slices.
